evaluated_tutor.identity_note: Proxima ZSP is evaluated in this study as an integrated system (tutoring policy, curriculum, session architecture) rather than as a bare model call. Unlike the four comparator conditions in this release — which are near-direct model access under a minimal Generic Tutor wrapper, and for which the underlying model is the primary identifying fact — Proxima ZSP's underlying model is one component among several and is not asserted as a standalone public field here. Implementation-level detail is documented in the accompanying paper's methodology, not in this dataset's per-condition model field.
